description:
Gene models of the three Ae. tauschii lineage reference assemblies (TA10171 lineage 1, TA1675 lineage 2, TA2576
lineage 3; Cavalet-Giorsa et al. 2024) matched by protein similarity (DIAMOND, best hit) to Ensembl Plants Ae.
tauschii Aet v4.0 and Chinese Spring RefSeq v1.1 D-genome genes. gene: an Aet.TA1675.r1... ID gives its position
and matches; a wheat symbol, IWGSC ID or Ensembl AET ID gives the matching genes in each lineage reference, with
genome-browser links. Best-hit matching is not orthology: check identity and coverage; a lineage with no match
may lack the gene or have a missed gene model.
name: aetauschii_gene
